facts.statement: Fossil lower jaws of T. lavocati show bite marks interpreted as the result of interspecific fights.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest these bite marks relate to behaviors like territoriality, hierarchy, and mating rights seen in modern male crocodilians.

facts.statement: It is debated whether similar behaviors in Dyrosauridae and modern crocodilians indicate an ancient trait inherited from a common ancestor.
